description: Check a whole mod in one call: the last error.log, the engine check (unknown effects, triggers and modifiers, duplicate ids, broken overrides), script validation, and the localisation and asset audits. Returns the 10 problems that matter most, each counted with 2 examples, its fix and the tool to use next, and which audits ran. Example: {"limit":5} or {"checks":["error_log","engine_check"]}. Takes up to a minute on a large mod.
name: hoi4.mod_health
title: Check a whole mod
